topPRs.title: feat(accounts): add OpenRouter and xAI inference authority
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- add canonical `openrouter-api` and `xai-api` linked-account identities across auth, vault, API, first-run, routing, shared contracts, and Settings UI
- authenticate new and replacement credentials before persistence; OpenRouter proves ownership through `/api/v1/key`, then discovers the complete deduplicated authenticated model catalog within a 1 MiB response bound
- route selected OpenRouter and xAI accounts through the existing encrypted multi-account pool and OpenAI-compatible inference environment
- generation-fence live credential export and retract prior authority before fallible selection/token reads, so disable/delete remains fail-closed even when reconciliation fails
- preserve displaced operator provider values and explicitly ledger operator-fallback `OPENAI_API_KEY` / `OPENAI_BASE_URL` aliases so route switches and resets restore the exact operator state
- enroll first-run OpenRouter/xAI credentials through the same authenticated encrypted account authority; config, wallet env, server identity/chat state, runtime character, and runtime settings remain staged until durable config commit, with clean rollback and retry after failure
- preserve product truth: OpenRouter is credits/BYOK and arbitrary-model inference, xAI is metered API inference, and neither account advertises coding-agent spawn or Grok consumer-subscription auth
- keep complete bounded diagnostics for existing direct providers while returning status-only failures for new OpenRouter/xAI enrollment so untrusted bodies cannot echo account secrets

- retract the removed runtime credential even when account metadata deletion fails after durable credential removal
- keep mobile account-dialog cancellation above persistent chat chrome using its existing clearance, and render the Enter-key hint correctly

Closes #24098.

## Relationship to the provider stack

- #24130 is merged and owns executable capability truth.
- #24205 is merged and owns native Kimi and Grok subscription adapters.
- This PR replaces the closed OpenCode-dependent #24229 with provider-neutral linked-account and inference authority on current `develop`.
- Paid live-provider trajectory certification remains #24100; no authorized OpenRouter or xAI credential was available here.

## Verification

Current reviewed head: `2609b42f644d3e395af04933228fe009cd012a73`, rebased onto `develop` at `8fea4f94c29c7712ce3caf303e3350150622d048`.

- Pinned Node 24.15.0 / Bun 1.3.14; canonical Cloud setup `ELIZA_SKIP_FUSED_INFERENCE_SETUP=1 bun install` passed (38.17s, no package changes).
- Full `bun run verify` passed: 376/376 tasks in 6m48.563s, followed by all repository audits. Final test-integrity scan: 11,452 files, zero focused tests or orphaned skips. Working tree is clean.
- Focused authority, auth, first-run, routing, pool, and UI suites passed 249 tests across 17 files at the prior source checkpoint. Subsequent rebases preserved those patches; the additional UI repair is covered by the fresh real-browser checks below. Provider requests in these focused suites are deterministic fixtures, not paid live acceptance.
- New real-renderer Playwright regression passed both 390px and 1440px cases (6.5s): open OpenRouter and xAI enrollment forms and click ordinary Cancel. Before the repair, the mobile click timed out because the persistent chat grabber intercepted it. No forced clicks are used.
- Full current-revision `bun run --cwd packages/app audit:app` passed: 219 checks, 216 view captures, zero broken/needs-work findings, and no hover-probe failures. Packaged OCR verified 204 captures, marked 12 for manual inspection, and found zero broken captures.
- Inspected Settings at all four audit viewports plus scoped OpenRouter/xAI picker rest/hover and credential forms on desktop/mobile. Cancel remains visible above the mobile chat bar. Scoped console captures contain no errors or warnings. Before/after screenshots and four MP4 walkthroughs are retained locally; inline attachment of these artifacts is still pending.

topPRs.title: fix(auth): serialize Steward session authority across browser tabs
topPRs.author: Kayvan-Zahiri
topPRs.body:
Fixes #30249

## Summary
- Add one origin-wide Steward session-authority coordinator (Web Lock + durable never-reset logout generation) and route cookie/token mutations through it: session sync, nonce exchange, refresh, callback/restore, passive mirroring, logout, and cookie DELETE.
- Capture expected token/generation before work and revalidate before persistence, before cookie mutation, after response settlement, and before publishing/clearing markers. Bound held network work with abort/timeout so a hung tab cannot strand the origin.
- Automatic SSO fails closed to ordinary login when origin-wide locks are unavailable. `session_ended` / `invalid_token` remain server-boundary codes and only clear the exact authority that received them.

## Tests
- Deterministic two-context auth-store/tab coverage for logout during persistence, logout during cookie sync, inverse A/B cookie vs storage, ABA logout→login→stale resume, stale passive sync, refresh/logout overlap, cleanup DELETE ordering, hung-lock release, and fail-closed SSO.
- No live SSO and no credential mutation.

## Coordination
Owns only the cross-tab session-authority primitive and integration boundaries. Does not duplicate #20848 or #29889.

topPRs.title: feat(cloud): configure and verify tenant PostgreSQL WAL recovery
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
# Relates to

Refs #21729 and #29488. Includes unmerged prerequisites from #30781 and #30792 because this draft targets develop.

# Change

Adds optional encrypted tenant PostgreSQL WAL/PITR configuration to the actual Ubuntu host bootstrap. A separate sensitive repository bundle is required; multiline configuration injection, Terraform state buckets and reuse of the logical-backup expiry bucket are rejected. New-host bootstrap configures synchronous encrypted WAL uploads with TLS verification, verifies the stanza and archive delivery, and establishes a full backup before scheduled backups/checks can run.

Weekly full and daily differential backups use systemd timers. The check must prove current WAL delivery and healthy current-generation backup receipts; it rejects completed backups older than 26 hours, full backups older than nine days, future timestamps, missing backups and repository errors. Explicit config includes prevent unrelated fragments from overriding managed configuration. No WAL queue-size discard cutoff is configured. Automatic expiry remains disabled pending independent deletion authority and restore proof.

# Verification

- Exact rebased head 54718f4e6cb0b2ff005ac5b04ded6d4e705ac0c6 passed root verification after install. Infrastructure source was unchanged by rebase.
- Infrastructure suite: 124 passed, 0 failed, 752 assertions. Native Terraform: 8 plans passed, including unsafe repository-input rejection. Actual rendered YAML parsed and extracted check script matched the tested source byte-for-byte.
- Rendered pgBackRest backup policy passed real PostgreSQL 16.15/pgBackRest 2.59.1 recovery over a local TLS S3 fixture with bad-credential and untrusted-CA rejection. Fixture-only identity, paths and credentials were substituted.
- Generated host files ran in a separate Ubuntu 24.04 VM with pgBackRest 2.50 and PostgreSQL16. An exclusively fixture-file-backed loop volume exercised exact-device bootstrap and one-use initialization. Restart preserved data. Actual systemd initialization, full backup, check and schedule readback passed.
- Separate Linux candidate restored a post-backup update and insert from WAL while the source remained deleted. A repository access failure produced check exit 41; restored access returned exit 0. All fixture timers/candidates and the VM were stopped afterward.

## Linux evidence excerpt

```text
tenant-db-init.service: Result=success, ExecMainStatus=0
tenant-db-pitr-init.service: Result=success, ExecMainStatus=0
tenant-db-pitr-check.service: Result=success, ExecMainStatus=0
effective data_directory: /mnt/tenant-pgdata/16/main
effective archive_mode: on
effective archive_timeout: 1min
restored rows: restored-wal-value, wal-only-insert
source row count after fixture deletion: 0
repository denied: Result=exit-code, ExecMainStatus=41
repository restored: Result=success, ExecMainStatus=0
eliza-cloud-pitr-proof: Stopped
```

# Evidence Gate

<!-- evidence-row:before-screenshots -->
- [x] N/A - no rendered UI change.
<!-- evidence-row:after-screenshots -->
- [x] N/A - no rendered UI change.
<!-- evidence-row:walkthrough-video -->
- [x] N/A - command-line host infrastructure.
<!-- evidence-row:backend-logs -->
- [ ] Local Linux execution excerpt above; deployed host/off-host repository logs pending.
<!-- evidence-row:frontend-logs -->
- [x] N/A - no frontend change.
<!-- evidence-row:llm-trajectory -->
- [x] N/A - no model-call or inference behavior change.
<!-- evidence-row:domain-artifacts -->
- [ ] Local restore and service outcomes above; actual independent repository receipts and production-sized restore evidence pending.
<!-- evidence-row:ocr-review -->
- [x] N/A - no rendered visual surface.

# Known gaps and deployment

Draft only. Linux proof used encrypted local storage; TLS S3 proof used a separate local fixture. Neither establishes real off-host storage durability, deployed credential scope, incident alert delivery, immutable retention or measured production RPO/RTO. Continuous control-plane and agent-state backup scope remains separate work. The check thresholds assess the daily/weekly schedule, not five-minute RPO.

Cloud-init is new-host bootstrap, not an in-place activation mechanism. Review any Terraform replacement and perform the documented data/role migration and write-fenced cutover. Null repository configuration leaves PITR inactive. Repository keys exist in sensitive Terraform state and cloud-init user data and need independently recoverable custody.

The first Linux drill placed its restore point before the fixture transaction committed and failed its assertion. The corrected drill committed before creating the restore point and passed into a new candidate; the failure was in the harness, not counted as successful recovery.

No deployment, live data migration, resource deletion or merge performed. No maintainer CI exception requested.

topPRs.title: fix(cloud): keep inference balance warm during settlement
topPRs.author: wakesync
topPRs.body:
## Outcome

Prevents a rapid post-stream inference request from seeing a transient missing organization-balance hint and failing with billing_cache_warming.

## Root cause

Streaming closes before off-response billing settlement finishes. The committed debit invalidated the inference balance hint, then settlement re-read the authoritative balance and republished it. A request in that handoff gap saw a cache-only miss.

## Fix

- Preserve the previous revisioned balance hint only for Durable Object-fenced live settlement and alarm recovery.
- Keep all other credit-cache invalidations, including legacy non-DO inference debit eviction.
- Replace the preserved hint with the authoritative post-debit balance and revision before releasing the admission lease.
- Keep the provider response stream independent of settlement latency.

Base: 64bbc6017571ba65f66fefe46dff267ea470e68c
Commit: 2a0368621df

## Verification

- 70 focused shared billing/admission/recovery tests pass.
- Concurrent admission overspend regression passes.
- Streaming response-before-billing regression passes.
- cloud/shared typecheck passes.
- Biome passes on all changed files.
- git diff --check passes.
